name: juridical personhood
definition: Entity is a legal person distinct from its members. LP1-LP3 usually move together but are demonstrably separable: waqf_khayri codes LP1=0 with LP2=P and LP3=P.

name: property in own name
definition: Capacity to hold and own property as the entity. See legal-personhood.

name: capacity to sue
definition: Standing to sue and be sued as an entity. See legal-personhood.

name: entity shielding weak
definition: Entity creditors prioritized over members' personal creditors in entity assets.

name: liquidation protection
definition: Members and their creditors cannot force partition or withdrawal of entity assets. OVERLAPS CI2 and may be redundant with it - AP2 adds the creditor dimension (members' creditors cannot force partition) that CI2 lacks. Flagged for review: candidate for merger rather than grouping.

name: owner shielding limited liability
definition: Members' personal assets shielded from entity creditors. Collapses with LR1, CF2 and LR6 to a single degree of freedom for bilateral capital-labour contracts; separable for entity forms, where a member can be shielded without any capital-labour asymmetry.

name: separation from founder estate
definition: The corpus leaves the founder's personal patrimony on constitution.

name: perpetual succession
definition: Entity persists across the death or exit of individual members. TS1=1 strongly constrains TS2 toward 'open'; the converse does not hold.

name: venture horizon
definition: Intended duration of the arrangement. See duration.

name: revocability
definition: Dissolvable or unwindable at will by a party (1 = revocable).

name: mutability of purpose
definition: Entity can alter its own rules or purpose by internal decision.

name: capital structure
definition: Form of the capital held or pooled.

name: capital lock-in
definition: Contributed capital cannot be withdrawn at will. See capital-immobility; overlaps AP2.

name: transferable interest
definition: Membership or ownership interest is alienable or tradable. CI4 entails CI3: an interest cannot be depersonalised without being transferable. The converse does not hold.

name: depersonalised interest
definition: Interest is negotiable independent of the holder's identity. Entails CI3.

name: liability extent
definition: Extent and form of members' liability for entity obligations. See agent-loss-exposure: for capital-labour contracts this restates AP3, CF2 and LR6 rather than adding evidence.

name: outcome coupling
definition: Degree to which decision-makers are exposed to the venture's outcomes.

name: profit-and-loss sharing
definition: Returns shared proportionally to stake rather than as a fixed claim.

name: risk pooling
definition: Mutualizes idiosyncratic risk across members versus unshielded. LR5 is .NA wherever LR4 is 0.

name: pooling correlation
definition: Correlation of the pooled baskets, which sets the sign of the pooling. Meaningful only where LR4 is not 0.

name: coupling symmetry
definition: Directionality of the decision-maker's exposure, where LR2 is not 'veiled'. symmetric: exposed to gains and losses alike. upside-only: shares gains, insulated from losses (a call option). downside-only: bears losses without a corresponding share of gains. LR2 records whether the decision-maker is bound to outcomes; LR6 records which way. Without it a qirad agent holding a call and an isqa manager holding a debt both read as merely 'coupled'. See agent-loss-exposure. Applies only where LR2 is not 'veiled'.

name: entitlement basis
definition: Basis of a participant's claim on the entity.

name: governance mode
definition: Locus of decision-making.

name: entry restriction
definition: Membership is closed or numerically restricted (1 = restricted). Meaningful only where MG1 is 'membership'.

name: authorization source
definition: Source of the entity's legal authorization.

name: purpose orientation
definition: Primary declared purpose.

name: monopoly franchise
definition: Holds an exclusive right or franchise as property.

name: identity wrapper
definition: The form confers legal-status or access arbitrage for its principals.

name: legibility registration
definition: Entity is registered and legible to political authority.

name: capital-labour asymmetry
definition: One party supplies capital, another labour or enterprise.

name: agent bears capital loss
definition: Working party bears loss of the principal's capital (0 = principal bears it). See agent-loss-exposure. Applies only where CF1 is present.

name: principal count
definition: Number of principals to the arrangement.
